question: Where was the Khelo India Winter Games 2025 second phase held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gulmarg**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Khelo India Winter Games 2025** is the **fifth edition** of this national-level multisport event, designed to promote winter sports culture and identify athletic talent across India.
 
• The **second phase** of the **2025** games was hosted in **Gulmarg**, situated in the **Baramulla district** of **Jammu and Kashmir**. This region is world-renowned for its snow-covered slopes and high-altitude terrain.
 
• While the **first phase** of the event took place in **Leh, Ladakh**, focusing on ice-based sports like **Ice Hockey** and **Ice Skating**, the **Gulmarg** phase was dedicated to snow-based disciplines.
 
• The event is organized by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** in collaboration with the **Sports Authority of India (SAI)** and the **Jammu & Kashmir Sports Council**.
 
• Key sports held during the **Gulmarg** phase included **Alpine Skiing**, **Nordic Skiing**, and **Snowboarding**, utilizing the specialized infrastructure of the **Gulmarg Gondola** and surrounding ridges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **History of Khelo India Winter Games:** The inaugural edition of the **Winter Games** was held in **2020**. Since then, **Gulmarg** and **Leh** have remained the primary venues due to their unique geographical advantages.
 
• **Significance of Gulmarg:** Known as the "Heartland of Winter Sports in India," **Gulmarg** sits at an elevation of approximately **2,650 meters**. It features the **Gulmarg Gondola**, which is one of the highest cable cars in the world, facilitating international-standard skiing competitions.
 
• **Objectives:** The primary goal of the **Khelo India** initiative is to strengthen the sports ecosystem at the grassroots level and prepare Indian athletes for international competitions like the **Winter Olympics**.
 
• **Economic and Tourism Impact:** Beyond sports, these games significantly boost **tourism** in **Jammu and Kashmir**. The influx of athletes, coaches, and spectators from across the country highlights the region as a safe and premier destination for global **winter tourism**.
 
• **Mascot and Identity:** Recent editions of the games have used the **Snow Leopard** (often referred to as **‘Sheen-e-She’** or **Shan**) as the mascot to raise awareness about Himalayan wildlife conservation and the spirit of resilience in high altitudes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Participation:** The **2025** games saw participation from various **Indian States**, **Union Territories**, and institutional teams like the **Services Sports Control Board (SSCB)** and the **Army Marksmanship Unit**.
 
• **Infrastructure Development:** Under the **Khelo India** scheme, the government has provided financial assistance to upgrade facilities in **Gulmarg**, including specialized grooming machines for snow slopes and safety equipment for athletes.
 
• **Talent Identification:** Top-performing athletes from the **Khelo India Winter Games** are often selected for specialized training camps funded by the **National Sports Development Fund**.
